ABOUT.TITLE: About KENZ BLADI
ABOUT.SUBTITLE: A digital platform dedicated to Moroccan artisanal heritage
ABOUT.INTRO_P1: KENZ BLADI (كنز بلادي, "Treasure of my country") is a digital ecosystem connecting Moroccan artisans, cooperatives and local producers with the world. Our goal is to promote ancestral know-how passed down from generation to generation.
ABOUT.INTRO_P2: Through a marketplace, a professional directory, tourism content and blog articles, we offer a modern digital showcase for Moroccan craftsmanship, available in French, Arabic, English and Darija.
ABOUT.MISSION_TEXT: Facilitate market access for Moroccan artisans and cooperatives, while preserving the authenticity and quality of their production.
ABOUT.VISION_TEXT: Become the digital reference for Moroccan artisanal heritage, internationally recognized for the quality and authenticity of its actors.

FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: Everything you need to know about KENZ BLADI

ITEMS.q: How do I register as an artisan on KENZ BLADI?
ITEMS.a: Contact the administrator via the contact form. A Pro account will be created for you with your personal credentials.

ITEMS.q: How do I add my products to the shop?
ITEMS.a: Once your Pro account is activated, go to your Pro space → Product management → Add.

ITEMS.q: In which languages is the platform available?
ITEMS.a: The platform is available in French, Arabic, English and Moroccan Darija.

ITEMS.q: How can I appear in the Pro Actors Directory?
ITEMS.a: Complete your profile in the Pro space. It will be reviewed by the administrator before publication.

ITEMS.q: Can I sell my products directly through the platform?
ITEMS.a: Yes, via the Marketplace. The platform offers several subscription plans: Free, Basic, Premium and Enterprise.
